# meok-transport-canada-hos-mcp

> Canadian Hours of Service (SOR/2005-313) + NSC Standard 9 + ELD mandate (T-T-019) + Provincial MoT audit prep. South-of-60 / North-of-60 / cycle-switch / cross-border CA-US callable compliance toolkit. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- check_canada_hos_south_60th
- check_canada_hos_north_60th
- check_eld_canada_mandate
- check_cycle_switch
- check_nsc_carrier_safety
- audit_cross_border_us_canada
- prepare_carrier_audit_pack

## Install
```
pip install meok-transport-canada-hos-mcp
```

- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/meok-transport-canada-hos-mcp/
